short_description: VPN not working after Windows update
description: User reported VPN stopped connecting after latest Windows update was applied. Authentication times out.
resolution: Reinstalled VPN client and cleared credential cache after update.

short_description: Cannot connect to VPN from home
description: Remote worker unable to establish VPN connection from home network. Gets auth error.
resolution: Reset VPN profile and re-enrolled MFA token.

description: VPN login fails with authentication error. Password confirmed correct.
resolution: Reset user password and VPN profile. MFA re-enrollment required.

description: VPN connection drops every 20-30 minutes. User has to reconnect manually.
resolution: Updated VPN client to latest version and adjusted timeout settings.

description: User gets authentication failure when connecting to corporate VPN. MFA not triggering.
resolution: Re-enrolled user MFA device and reset VPN credentials.

description: Microsoft Outlook fails to launch on Windows startup. Shows loading screen then crashes.
resolution: Repaired Office installation via control panel.

description: Outlook crashes randomly throughout the day. Event logs show memory error.
resolution: Updated Outlook to latest patch and disabled problematic add-ins.

description: User unable to open email attachments in Outlook. Application becomes unresponsive.
resolution: Cleared Outlook cache and rebuilt profile.

description: Outlook hangs when user tries to send emails with attachments larger than 5MB.
resolution: Configured attachment size limit and cleared send/receive cache.

description: Outlook shows profile error on startup. Cannot access mailbox.
resolution: Created new Outlook profile and migrated mailbox data.

description: User locked out of Windows. Password not accepted at login screen.
resolution: Reset user password in Active Directory and unlocked account.

description: Login screen freezes after entering credentials. System becomes unresponsive.
resolution: Repaired Windows boot configuration and reset user profile.

description: User account locked after multiple failed login attempts.
resolution: Unlocked Active Directory account and reset password.

description: User password expired and cannot log in. Self-service portal not accessible.
resolution: Reset password via admin console and enabled temporary access.

short_description: Multi-factor authentication not working for Windows login
description: MFA prompt not appearing during Windows login. User bypassing second factor.
resolution: Re-enrolled user in MFA system and verified policy enforcement.

description: Office printer queue shows jobs stuck. Nothing prints.
resolution: Cleared print queue and restarted print spooler service.

description: User unable to add shared network printer. Driver installation fails.
resolution: Manually installed correct print driver and re-mapped shared printer.

description: New printer driver fails to install on Windows 11. Error code 0x000003e3.
resolution: Downloaded driver from manufacturer site and installed in compatibility mode.

description: Printer appears offline in Windows despite being powered on and connected.
resolution: Reset TCP/IP port for printer and cleared spooler queue.

description: Multiple print jobs stuck in queue. Printer showing as busy but not printing.
resolution: Restarted print spooler service and cleared all stuck jobs.

description: User receives access denied when navigating to SharePoint team site.
resolution: Granted user appropriate SharePoint permissions and cleared browser cache.

description: File upload to SharePoint library fails with permission error.
resolution: Fixed SharePoint library permissions and re-enabled versioning.

description: SharePoint site shows blank page or fails to load in browser.
resolution: Identified broken web part and restored from previous version.

description: SharePoint search returns no results for documents known to exist.
resolution: Triggered search index rebuild and recrawl of document library.

short_description: Cannot sync SharePoint folder to desktop
description: SharePoint OneDrive sync fails with conflict errors.
resolution: Reset OneDrive sync client and re-established SharePoint connection.

description: User laptop takes 10+ minutes to boot and applications run extremely slowly.
resolution: Removed malware

description: PC performance degraded significantly after Windows feature update.
resolution: Rolled back problematic update and optimised startup configuration.

description: CPU usage at 100% constantly. System barely usable.
resolution: Identified rogue process consuming CPU and terminated it. Updated antivirus definitions.

description: Business application taking 5+ minutes to load. Was working fine last week.
resolution: Cleared application cache and increased virtual memory allocation.

description: File transfers and web browsing very slow. Other devices on same network fine.
resolution: Updated network adapter driver and reset TCP/IP stack.

description: Corporate email not syncing on iOS device. Inbox not updating.
resolution: Re-configured Exchange ActiveSync profile on device.

description: Email application on Android shows authentication error after password change.
resolution: Updated email profile with new credentials and re-enrolled device.

description: No new emails arriving on mobile device despite working on desktop.
resolution: Deleted and recreated email account on device with correct server settings.

description: User accidentally deleted email account on mobile and cannot re-add.
resolution: Guided user through re-adding corporate email account with MFA.

description: Email application crashes immediately on launch on mobile device.
resolution: Cleared app cache and updated to latest version of email client.

description: Mapped network drive shows disconnected. Cannot access shared files.
resolution: Remapped network drive and updated group policy for persistent connections.

description: User unable to map new network drive. Credentials not accepted.
resolution: Fixed user permissions on file server and remapped drive letter.

description: Access denied when opening files on shared network drive.
resolution: Corrected NTFS and share permissions for user group.

description: Several folders missing from network drive after server maintenance.
resolution: Restored missing folders from backup. Verified data integrity.

description: Opening files from network drive takes very long. Local files fine.
resolution: Identified network bottleneck and optimised SMB settings.

description: Application installation fails at 60% with error code 1603.
resolution: Ran Windows Installer cleanup and reinstalled with elevated privileges.

description: Software Center shows application as available but installation fails silently.
resolution: Re-targeted SCCM deployment and cleared client cache.

description: Third-party application installer crashes repeatedly during setup.
resolution: Installed required prerequisites and ran installer as administrator.

description: Mandatory software update shows as failed in management console.
resolution: Manually triggered update via command line and verified installation.

description: Antivirus definitions out of date. Update mechanism failing.
resolution: Re-registered agent with management console and forced definition update.

description: Wireless connection drops intermittently throughout the day.
resolution: Updated wireless adapter driver and adjusted power management settings.

description: Device cannot join corporate WiFi network. Authentication rejected.
resolution: Re-issued WiFi certificate and updated 802.1x profile on device.

description: Wireless network speeds very slow compared to wired connection.
resolution: Changed WiFi channel to reduce interference and upgraded to 5GHz band.

description: Corporate WiFi SSID not appearing in available networks on laptop.
resolution: Enabled SSID broadcast on affected access point and updated firmware.

description: WiFi connection fails with certificate expired error.
resolution: Renewed WiFi authentication certificate and pushed to devices via MDM.

description: Self-service password reset portal returns error when user attempts reset.
resolution: Fixed SSPR configuration in Azure AD and verified user registration.

description: User forgot password and cannot access self-service reset tool.
resolution: Manually reset password via helpdesk and enrolled user in SSPR.

description: Password reset rejected due to complexity policy. User confused by requirements.
resolution: Guided user through password requirements and completed reset.

description: User account disabled after too many failed password attempts.
resolution: Re-enabled account and reset password. Advised on secure practices.

description: Authenticator app not generating valid OTP codes. Always invalid.
resolution: Re-enrolled user MFA device and re-synced authenticator app time.

description: Application throws database connection timeout after 30 seconds.
resolution: Increased connection pool size and optimised slow queries.

description: Application unable to establish connection to production database.
resolution: Restarted SQL Server service and corrected firewall rules blocking port 1433.

description: Specific report query taking 45 minutes to complete. Was 2 minutes before.
resolution: Added missing index on frequently queried column. Query now takes 3 seconds.

description: SQL Server authentication failing for application service account.
resolution: Reset service account password and updated connection strings in application config.

description: SQL Server database drive at 98% capacity. Alerts firing.
resolution: Expanded database volume and implemented automated log truncation.

description: Microphone not detected in Microsoft Teams meetings.
resolution: Set correct default audio device in Windows and Teams settings.

description: Teams meeting link opens browser instead of Teams app and fails to join.
resolution: Repaired Teams installation and set Teams as default handler for meeting links.

description: Camera not showing in Teams video calls. Device manager shows no issues.
resolution: Updated camera driver and cleared Teams cache.

description: Teams application crashes mid-call. Other participants unaffected.
resolution: Cleared Teams cache and disabled GPU hardware acceleration.

description: User cannot see or access shared Teams channels after team restructure.
resolution: Re-added user to correct Teams and channels with appropriate permissions.

description: Google Chrome fails to load any web pages. Shows ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED.
resolution: Flushed DNS cache and reset Windows network stack.

description: Internal website returns 403 forbidden for user.
resolution: Updated proxy exception list and cleared browser proxy settings.

description: Browser shows certificate error for internal web application.
resolution: Renewed SSL certificate and deployed to web server.

description: Internal site redirects to wrong URL. Infinite redirect loop.
resolution: Fixed IIS redirect rules and cleared browser cache.

description: Approved website blocked by browser security extension.
resolution: Added site to extension allowlist via group policy.

description: USB external hard drive not showing in Windows Explorer.
resolution: Updated USB driver and initialised drive in Disk Management.

description: USB device plugged in but Windows shows device not recognised error.
resolution: Cleared USB driver registry entries and reinstalled controller driver.

description: Front USB ports on desktop not functioning. Rear ports fine.
resolution: Replaced internal USB header cable that had come loose.

short_description: Cannot copy files to USB drive
description: Files fail to copy to USB drive. Error: device not ready.
resolution: Formatted USB drive and updated removable media policy.

description: Bluetooth headset cannot pair with laptop. Pairing fails every time.
resolution: Updated Bluetooth driver and cleared paired device list.

description: Email with PDF attachment blocked by email security gateway.
resolution: Whitelisted sender domain and re-delivered blocked message.

description: Large volume of phishing emails bypassing spam filter.
resolution: Updated spam filter rules and enabled advanced threat protection.

description: Outbound emails to external recipients bouncing with relay denied error.
resolution: Fixed mail relay configuration and updated SPF DNS record.

description: Legitimate vendor email flagged as phishing and quarantined.
resolution: Released email from quarantine and added vendor to safe senders list.

description: Emails sent to department distribution list not reaching members.
resolution: Rebuilt distribution list membership and corrected SMTP address.

description: User locked out after losing access to authenticator app.
resolution: Verified identity via manager approval and reset MFA registration.

short_description: Cannot setup MFA on new phone
description: MFA app setup failing on new smartphone. QR code scan not working.
resolution: Provided manual entry code and completed MFA registration.

description: Time-based MFA tokens expiring too quickly. Clock sync issue.
resolution: Synced device clock with NTP server. Tokens now valid.

description: User factory reset phone and lost MFA authenticator setup.
resolution: Re-enrolled user in MFA after identity verification.

description: Hardware security token not accepted by system. Getting invalid token error.
resolution: Resynchronised hardware token with authentication server.

description: OneDrive shows sync paused and files not uploading to cloud.
resolution: Re-authenticated OneDrive with corporate credentials and resumed sync.

description: OneDrive quota exceeded. Cannot save new files to cloud.
resolution: Cleared old files and increased user storage allocation to 1TB.

description: Documents saved locally not appearing in OneDrive cloud.
resolution: Reset OneDrive sync client and re-established folder sync.

description: Duplicate conflict copies appearing for shared OneDrive files.
resolution: Resolved conflicts manually and configured co-authoring settings.

description: OneDrive web portal returns access denied for user.
resolution: Fixed Microsoft 365 licence assignment and cleared SSO token cache.
